description: The two fused axes of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, both silent-error class, both found by reading the model's own implementation rather than its header.
name: qwen3-6-35b-a3b.split-to-fused
provenance: Both facts are LIVE CONSTRAINTS, not annotations: forcing the wrong shares makes the derived topology disagree with the catalog's record and the corpus refuses to load.

seams.provenance: RATIFIED 2026-08-20 (tensorfs#150), transplanted from `qwen3.6-35b-a3b.vllm-fp8@1`. `self_attn.q_proj` is Linear(hidden, num_heads * head_dim * 2) and the doubling is a per-head GATE, split HEAD-MAJOR into (q, gate) — 16 groups, not one flat two-way cut. THE GROUP COUNT IS THE FACT: a flat split is right for head 0 and wrong for the other 15. Measured shape [8192, 2048].

RATIFIED 2026-08-20 (tensorfs#150), transplanted from `qwen3.6-35b-a3b.vllm-fp8@1`. `linear_attn.in_proj_qkv` is q|k|v at 1:1:2 — NOT equal thirds. Measured [8192, 2048]: 8192 / 4 = 2048, so q and k are 2048 rows each and v is 4096. Equal thirds does not even divide, which is the only reason this one is loud rather than silent.
